questions.q: In an if / elif / else chain, how many branches run?
options: Only the first branch whose condition is True; the rest are skipped
Every branch whose condition is True
Always the else branch, regardless of the conditions
questions.explain: Python checks conditions top to bottom and runs only the first True branch.

questions.q: What does continue do inside a for loop?
options: Pauses the loop until a key is pressed
Restarts the entire loop from the beginning
Exits the loop immediately, skipping all remaining items
Skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next item
questions.explain: continue jumps to the next iteration without running the remaining code for the current one.

questions.q: What does break do inside a loop?
options: Exits the loop immediately, regardless of remaining items
Has no effect inside a for loop
Skips only the current item, then continues the loop
Converts the loop into a while loop
questions.explain: break stops the loop entirely, as soon as it's encountered.

questions.q: What values does range(5) produce when used in a for loop?
questions.explain: range(5) starts at 0 and stops before 5, producing exactly 5 values.

questions.q: Why is a while loop a better fit than a for loop for retrying a failed connection?
options: while loops are always faster than for loops
for loops cannot contain if statements
The number of retry attempts needed isn't known in advance; a while loop repeats until a condition changes
while loops can only be used with numbers, never with conditions
questions.explain: A while loop is the right tool when you don't know ahead of time how many iterations you'll need.
